canonical_engine.entry: first trading day of each calendar month
canonical_engine.financing: self-financing cash account accrued on calendar days at the entry zero rate
canonical_engine.maturity: nearest expiry to 30 calendar days within a 21-45 day band
canonical_engine.realised_variance: sum of squared close-to-close log returns / year fraction
canonical_engine.strip: full CBOE model-free strip, zero-bid truncation

exposure_rule.fallback: if a strip cannot be built or the spot path is incomplete, the month is skipped
exposure_rule.rationale: No signal earned the right to move it. Every adaptive rule tested lost its advantage when a single two-month episode was removed, and none had a stable parameter neighbourhood combined with a positive paired mean against its own flat control.

name: V6 canonical unconditional variance carry
participation_rule: none - every scheduled month is traded

pre_registered_diagnostics.purpose: Not strategy candidates and not comparators for the selection. These three rules scored best in development and are frozen here so that their out-of-sample behaviour is a genuine pre-registered test of the hypothesis this phase rejects, rather than a search run after the fact.
pre_registered_diagnostics.stated_expectation: If the development advantage of these rules was a single-crisis artifact, their OOS edge over a same-average-exposure control should be approximately zero or negative, except in any month that contains a comparable variance shock.

selection: section 25 option B - the canonical unconditional baseline, because no adaptive rule genuinely improved it
